description: watchdog.setEnabled that DISABLES (true -> false) with the digest of the disable statement: a disable loosens a safeguard (a rule that will no longer fire), so it commits only against the digest of the canonical statement the daemon rendered from the row AS READ — the S45 PM7.1 pattern, the T8 budget shape. The digest here is the SHA-256 of the statement text in this fixture, so a client can recompute it; a digest that does not match rides confirm-mismatch (the row moved since the read), and the same request without a confirm rides the confirm-required refusal (errors/watchdog-refused-confirm-required.json). A re-enable in the other direction tightens and is free; a set that changes nothing is a noop that writes no audit row.

result.statement: disable watchdog rule wdr-2 (workspace workspace, step-over-deadline stop, threshold 1h): after this it will no longer fire
